最后一排的作业本: The Workbook in the Back Row
班里一个孩子总交白卷。教研组催你交公开课材料，孩子的家长只说工作忙。你把那本空作: A child in your class keeps handing in blank papers. The teaching group presses you for open-lesson materials, and the child's parents only say they're busy at work. You leave the empty workbook on your desk.
先问清孩子卡在哪里: First find out where the child is stuck
跟教研组磨一套分层作业: Work out a tiered homework set with the teaching group
你发现他连前一年的题都没跟上。每天放学多留十分钟，从那里补起。: You find he hasn't even caught up with last year's material. Every day after school you keep him ten extra minutes and start from there.
你和同事改了几轮题。有人觉得麻烦，试了一个学期，终于少了几本白卷。: You and your colleagues revise the questions over several rounds. Some find it a hassle, but after a term there are finally fewer blank papers.
一届届学生换过去。有人回来看你，说起的总是当年放学后那十分钟。: Class after class of students goes by. Some come back to see you, and what they talk about is always those ten minutes after school.
你把试过的作业装订成册，新老师来带班，先借这本看。: You bind the homework sets you tried into a booklet, and new teachers taking over a class borrow it first.
五十岁了，批改作业要戴老花镜。碰到空白处，你还是会把孩子叫来问一句。有人毕业后带: At fifty, you need reading glasses to mark homework. Faced with a blank, you still call the child over to ask. Some come back after graduating with their own children, wanting you to hear out the child's difficulties first.
教研会开完，你留下来听年轻老师试讲。后来几次新课试教，都先把作业册送来请你一起改: After the teaching meeting, you stay to hear a young teacher's trial lesson. In later trial runs of new lessons, they always send the workbooks over first for you to mark together.
清早交班，一个病人的复查指标还没出来。家属攥着缴费单追着问，你的夜班已经上了十二: At the early-morning handover, one patient's follow-up results aren't back yet. The family clutches the payment slip and keeps asking, and you've already worked twelve hours of night shift.
把病情和下一步写清楚再交班: Write out the condition and next steps clearly before handing over
报名科里的病例讨论，补这一类经验: Sign up for the department's case discussions to build experience in this area

你把病历带到讨论会上。几个老医生问得很细，你的本子记满了。: You bring the case file to the discussion. The senior doctors ask in detail, and your notebook fills up.
年轻医生找你核对交班单。你把最容易漏的那一项圈出来，让他再查一次。: A young doctor asks you to check the handover sheet. You circle the item most easily missed and have him check it again.
疑难病例讨论多由你主持。你先让最年轻的人说，再一条条核对依据。: You often chair difficult-case discussions. You let the youngest speak first, then check the evidence point by point.
科里给你少排了夜班。下班经过病房，你仍会看一眼那张交班表。: The department schedules you fewer night shifts. Passing the ward after work, you still glance at that handover sheet.
五十岁的门诊，总有人拿着多年前的病历来找你。封面旧了，记录还清楚。: In your clinic at fifty, someone always turns up with a medical record from years ago. The cover is worn, but the notes are still clear.
交班前，走廊的呼叫铃又响了。新来的同事配药很慢，一个老人刚做完手术，翻身需要两个: Before the handover, the call bell in the corridor rings again. The new colleague is slow at dispensing, and an elderly patient who has just had surgery needs two people to turn.
先和同事把床旁的事理顺: First sort out the bedside work with your colleague
争取专科护理培训的名额: Compete for a place in specialist nursing training
你们把时间重新排了排，先去照顾术后那一床。老人抓着你的手说谢谢。: You reschedule your time and attend to the post-surgery bed first. The old man grips your hand and thanks you.

新护士第一天值班，你陪她对完医嘱。她紧张得忘了带笔，你递过去一支。: On the new nurse's first shift, you go through the orders with her. She's so nervous she forgot her pen, so you hand her one.
专科护理门诊开始排你的班。有人带来一袋用过的敷料，问自己换得对不对。: The specialist nursing clinic starts scheduling you. Someone brings a bag of used dressings and asks whether they changed them correctly.

调度临时加了一趟夜路。送到能多拿 ¥1,200，但你的眼皮已经发沉，路上还有一段: Dispatch adds a last-minute night run. Delivering it pays ¥1,200 more, but your eyelids are already heavy, and there's a stretch of mountain road ahead.

和调度谈固定白班线路: Ask dispatch for a fixed daytime route

报名做站里的新手带教: Sign up to mentor newcomers at the station

快递站又换了一个分拣员。包裹堆到门口，有人拿错件，有人说你关门太早。盘点完已经十: The parcel station has changed sorters again. Parcels pile up at the door; someone takes the wrong item, someone says you close too early. By the time the stocktake is done it's half past ten.

你更多做白天的指导。年轻妈妈翻开记录本时，你先让她坐下喝口水。: You do more daytime coaching now. When a young mother opens the log book, you first make her sit down for a sip of water.

慢慢问清习惯，按点照护: Ask patiently about his habits and care by the clock
去学失能照护和沟通: Study care for the disabled and communication
你发现老人只是不习惯饭菜太硬。换成软饭以后，勺子终于动了。: You find the old man simply isn't used to food that's too hard. After switching to soft rice, the spoon finally moves.

一行做久了: A Long Time in the Trade
